title: Small dinosaur fossil suggests Fukushima coast hosted iguanodontians of different sizes
description: Iguanodontians are a diverse group of herbivorous dinosaurs that lived from the Late Jurassic to the Late Cretaceous and had a worldwide distribution. Intercontinental dispersal events between Asia, North America and Europe played a key role in their diversification across Laurasia. Fossils discovered in Japan provide valuable insights into the evolution and biogeography of iguanodontians.

title: Chinese proverb of the day: “As heaven moves with ceaseless strength, the noble person strives unceasingly to...” — Timeless life lessons on resilience, self-discipline, perseverance, purpose, and why lasting success begins with mastering yourself from the ancient Chinese classic I Ching
description: Today's Chinese proverb of the day shares timeless wisdom from the ancient I Ching. “As heaven moves with ceaseless strength, the noble person strives unceasingly to strengthen himself.” This powerful Chinese proverb reminds us that real success begins with self-discipline, resilience, and daily growth. Its message is simple, practical, and just as meaningful in today's fast-changing world as it was thousands of years ago.
